class_selection_screen.rpgclassselection:
The Arcane Wizard uses pure energy to focus powerful attacks on single targets
- Strengths: Focused magical damage against individual enemies
- Weaknesses: Very low defense
- Equipment: Lightly armored

The Archer uses ranged weapons and archery skills to defeat enemies from afar
- Strengths: Dealing high damage at range and maintaining mobility
- Weaknesses: Heavily armored enemies
- Equipment: Moderately armored

The Fire Wizard uses fiery magic to defeat enemies both near and far
- Strengths: Magical damage dealt at large areas
- Weaknesses: Low defense and mobility
- Equipment: Lightly armored

The Frost Wizard uses cold magic to slow enemies and control the battlefield
- Strengths: Magical damage that slows and freezes enemies
- Weaknesses: Low defense and mobility
- Equipment: Lightly armored

The Paladin uses weapons and spells to attack enemies and support allies
- Strengths: Versatile in battle, able to heal, strike, and defend
- Weaknesses: Limited ranged attacks and mobility
- Equipment: Heavily armored

The Priest uses holy magic to heal allies and damage enemies
- Strengths: Supporting and healing allies, destroying undead
- Weaknesses: Low damage and poor physical defense
- Equipment: Lightly armored

The Rogue uses quick weapons and skills to strike enemies from the shadows
- Strengths: High mobility and melee attack damage
- Weaknesses: Mediocre defense and limited ranged attacks
- Equipment: Moderately armored

The Warrior uses heavy weapons and skills to dominate close combat
- Strengths: Strong melee attacks with good mobility
- Weaknesses: Limited ranged attacks and supportive skills
- Equipment: Heavily armored

The Rogue Archer uses fast ranged weapons and tricky archery skills to slowly defeat enemies.
- Strengths: Inflicting harmful effects and making sure not to be caught.
- Weaknesses: Heavily armored enemies
- Equipment: Moderately armored

The Tundra Hunter uses balanced ranged weapons and freezing projectiles.
- Strengths: Slowing and freezing enemies.
- Weaknesses: Heavily armored and CC immune targets.
- Equipment: Moderately armored

The War Archer uses fast high ranged damage weapons to cause explosions and heavy damage.
- Strengths: High Burst Damage.
- Weaknesses: Fast and tricky Enemies
- Equipment: Heavily armored
